review.assessment: This change introduces three new channel modules (`promo_sms.py`, `push.py`, `winback.py`) that define audience filtering logic solely based on contact attributes like email or segment, but entirely omit any check for the `do_not_contact` flag required by policy. Because these files lack opt-out filtering, they will continue to include opted-out contacts in campaign audiences and fail the requirement that counts reflect actual policy compliance. The outbound plan therefore does not obey the stated marketing rules despite executing without runtime errors.

findings.actual: All three files lack any reference to `do_not_contact`; they only check for empty phone/push_token/email fields and include all matching IDs regardless of opt-out status.
findings.defect: Missing do-not-contact filter across new channel modules
findings.expected: Each audience() implementation must explicitly exclude contacts where contact.do_not_contact is true, preventing opted-out users like Bo from receiving further marketing messages.
